key_findings.finding: The name-based structure gives the same elemental counts: oxan contributes a six-membered ring containing five carbons and one oxygen; the 3-propoxy substituent adds three carbons and one oxygen; the 4-amine nitrogen bears a methyl group, adding one carbon and one nitrogen.
